desc.en: A Slag with an ominous appearance. It sneaks up behind intruders without making a sound, before quickly turning their blades on them and slicing them to pieces. They stand out conspicuously when outdoors, but are dangerous nonetheless.
desc.ja: 不気味な風貌をしたスラグ。背後から音も無く忍び寄り、下部にある刃を高速回転させて侵入者を切り刻むという。屋外ではよく目立つが、危険なことには変わりない
